Ethan Support: quick flag — customer 'Brightline' (acct BR-998) hit onboarding stall. Activation emails bounced after SSO provision, trial seats stuck. Support triaged, suspect SAML metadata mismatch. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/67890
Priya CS: thanks for the heads up. Is renewal at risk? who's their CSM? @Jordan?
Ethan Support: Renewal due in 55 days. CSM on record is Jordan. Customer is on an enterprise trial; they're in product evaluation with 3 teams.
Jordan CS Manager: I'm here. thanks @Ethan. Can you paste the error from the logs and the exact SSO metadata we sent?
Ethan Support: copying logs:
```
Auth error: saml_parse_response: NameID format mismatch
SP metadata used: https://sso.brightline.com/metadata.xml
```
Ethan Support: I tried re-provisioning, got same error. Support has a hotfix pending from IdP; ETA ~3h.
Priya CS: ok — plan: 1) warm transfer to CS within 30m, 2) send controlled comms to customer with temporary bypass steps, 3) schedule enablement call tomorrow. Jordan, can you own the handoff?
Jordan CS Manager: I can own it. Jordan -> runbook: create a shared calendar invite, add triage notes, set success metric: seats activated by EOD tomorrow. I'll also ask Solutions to prepare fallback.
Sam Solutions: I'll prepare a short fallback doc (SSO bypass steps + token refresh commands). Draft:
- disable strict NameID check in test env
- run `redwood auth refresh --tenant BR-998 --force`
- validate with `curl -v https://app.brightline.com/_status`
Priya CS: perfect. For comms: I'll draft two templates — one technical for IdP admins and one customer friendly. @Ethan please send the customer-safe note now: "we're working on a temporary workaround; will follow up with a scheduled call" :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Ethan Support: sent initial note at 4032109890. customer replied: "appreciate the quick response — will be ready for a call anytime tomorrow AM PST." :thumbsup: 
Jordan CS Manager: clearing next steps: Jordan to run warm transfer now, Sam to share doc in #eng-ml for review, Priya to prepare renewal risk playbook entry. I'll update the account health score to 'at-risk — onboarding' and flag renewal.
Priya CS: I'll own the renewal watch: add a 7-day cadence touch and escalate to AE if no progress. Also save feedback: onboarding SSO parity docs were missing IdP examples.
OpsBot: Reminder: create task BR-998-handshake assigned to Jordan in 2m.
Priya CS: thanks team. I'll post follow-up summary in this thread after the call. :white_check_mark:
